description:
About GlobalFoundries: 
 GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com.

 Summary of Role: 
 As a Member of Technical Staff of Tapeout and Mask Organization , the engineering candidate will work with our global team of engineers and product owners on business transformation projects that drive process optimizations and product modernization. This individual will be exposed to complex Electronic Design Automation (EDA) flows, cloud technology transformations, and industry best practices.

 Join a team that offers exceptional career growth through: 
 Hands‑on work with cutting‑edge cloud technologies, partnering closely with Product Lines, Manufacturing Fabs, Customer Sales, EDA and cloud vendors, and IT teams to streamline and modernize tapeout workflows
 Opportunities to make visible impact by driving efficiency and improving quality through innovative tools—such as an interactive design studio that integrates EDA tools, LSF cost analytics, and tapeout metrics
 Exposure to complex, real‑world technology challenges, delivered using agile methodologies and deep cross‑functional collaboration, enabling you to build a strong, end‑to‑end understanding of the customer tapeout lifecycle
 
 Essential Responsibilities: 
 Enable scalable, Electronic Design Automation (EDA) functions in a Cloud environment
 Continuous improvement of secure on-premises automation flows
 Continuously learn and explore new technologies and trends in tapeout interactive tool/app development, including AI/ML technologies and AWS services
 Create data visualizations, tools to view EDA tool outputs to bring process improvements and documentation
 Data analytics on Tapeout processing key performance indicators (KPIs), to drive optimized performance of Cloud Tapeout execution
 Support customer Tapeouts, Mask manufacturing enablement, Fab Wafer start enablement
 Developing business process improvement tools in cloud utilizing out-of-the-box services
 Other Responsibilities: 
 Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs
 Other duties as assigned by manager / supervisor
 
 Required Qualifications: 
 Education – BS + 6-7 years of relevant experience degree in electrical, computer engineering, physics, and/or related field from an accredited degree program OR MS degree + 4-5 years relevant experience OR PhD + 2-3 years relevant experience
 Prior experience in Tapeout operations highly preferred
 Semiconductor device design and validation knowledge
 Experience developing Electronic Design Automation (EDA) flows and automation
 Proficient within Linux/Unix system environments
 Knowledge of relational and non-relational databases to process tapeout / EDA data
 Language Fluency - English (both Written & Verbal)
 Architecting and developing process improvement automations and KPI metrics using tools such as Python / On-Prem / various cloud platforms
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, planning & organizational skills
 Project management skills, i.e. the ability to innovate and execute solutions that matter; the ability to navigate ambiguity
 Applicant must be a US person (lawful permanent resident and/or green card holder)
 Must be eligible to obtain and maintain an export control license
 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience or certification in Structured Problem Solving (8D) / FMEA
 Experience integrating AI agents and tools into business processes
 Knowledge of cybersecurity tools and best practices; experience with Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) enablement
 Knowledge of project life cycles, exposure to project managements tools like Azure Dev-Ops, JIRA
 Experience with integration pipeline tools such as Bamboo, GIT, Jenkins etc.
 Must be proactive, with a desire to continuously improve system solutions, process documentation, and operating procedures
 
 
 Expected Salary Range 
$98,000.00 - $176,000.00 
 The exact Salary will be determined based on qualifications, experience and location.
 
 The role you are applying for may require you to obtain a US Department of Defense Security Clearance at some time during your employment. Acceptance of this role commits to applying for such if requested. Further, the applicant consents to being asked questions about their citizenship and background to assess the likelihood of obtaining a Security Clearance. The applicant also acknowledges that GlobalFoundries can only nominate and submit an application for a Security Clearance. The granting of a Security Clearance is at the sole discretion of the U.S. Government and the Department of Defense. 







 
 If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at usaccommodations@gf.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Requests for accommodation will be considered on a case-by-case basis. Please note that only inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address.   

   

 An offer with GlobalFoundries is conditioned upon the successful completion of pre-employment conditions, as applicable, and subject to applicable laws and regulations.   

   

 GlobalFoundries is fully committed to equal opportunity in the workplace and believes that cultural diversity within the company enhances its business potential. GlobalFoundries goal of excellence in business necessitates the attraction and retention of highly qualified people. Artificial barriers and stereotypic biases detract from this objective and may be illegally discriminatory.   

   

 All policies and processes which pertain to employees including recruitment, selection, training, utilization, promotion, compensation, benefits, extracurricular programs, and termination are created and implemented without regard to age, ethnicity, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic or category specified by local, state or federal law
